title: Components, Composables, Stores & Routing Boundaries
objectives: Decide what belongs in a component vs composable vs store
Treat route components as composition roots

examples.name: useCart.ts

exercise.prompt: Place each concern in its right home: "fetch + abort handling" (composable), "cross-page shared state" (store), "button styling" (component), "per-route data loading" (route component).
hints: Composables own reusable behavior; stores own shared state.
Route components compose features and trigger loading for their subtree.

questions.prompt: A composable differs from a store because it…
options: scopes behavior to its caller instead of sharing global state
questions.explanation: Composables are per-caller behavior; stores are shared state with an app-wide lifecycle.

options: the only place API calls live
questions.explanation: Pages compose feature components; logic lives in composables/services below.
